CreateRun.description: Choose exactly one non-null decisionId, demoKey, or majorCode. majorCode supports self-directed starts without requiring a recommendation; identity, consent, content availability and run-state checks still apply.

expectedSourceRevisions.description: Required for task-manifest-v3 (including empty object); optional for v1/v2. Must exactly equal saved ancestor revisions. Current-step revision remains inputRevision.

productEligible.description: Server-derived product eligibility. Optional for legacy receipts; only true admits a historical REVIEW_PREVIEW to the product report flow. Does not rewrite runMode or prove expert review/public release.

expectedSourceRevisions.description: Required for task-manifest-v3 (including empty object); optional for v1/v2. Must exactly equal saved ancestor revisions. Current-step revision remains inputRevision.

ExecuteDS.description: Strict v3 DS request; the shared endpoint still accepts legacy v1/v2 Execute. Server validates the task-specific source contract.

expectedSourceRevisions.description: Required for v4, including {} when there are no ancestors. Exactly the saved source revisions consumed by this operation.

ExecuteBA.description: Strict v4 BA execution. Saved bindings are authoritative; an empty own binding list is valid for ba-funnel. The shared endpoint preserves legacy request compatibility.

guide.description: Immutable method-guide-v1 bound to the pinned task; supports and schemas are PUBLIC teaching content.

record.description: Immutable server-generated local-result record, not a client score or proof of Excel activity.
